Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Compound Structures, Molecule Dictionary. Join: Activities to Compound Structures on molregno, Compound Structures to Molecule Dictionary on molregno. Filter: assay_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613918', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
